questions.text: Explain Drawing Instruments, Sheet Layout (A0 to A4 sizes), Title Block, and Standard Scales (Full scale $1:1$, Reducing scale $1:2, 1:5$, Enlarging scale $2:1, 5:1$). Explain Lettering styles and Dimensioning rules (Aligned vs Unidirectional systems).

Construct a Diagonal Scale of Representative Fraction $RF = 1/50$ to read meters, decimeters, and centimeters, long enough to measure up to $6\text{ m}$. Show a distance of $4.76\text{ m}$ on the scale.
Construct a Vernier Scale of $RF = 1/25$ to read up to $4\text{ m}$ and mark a distance of $2.38\text{ m}$.
Construct an Involute of a circle of diameter $50\text{ mm}$. Draw a normal and tangent at any point on the curve.

Construct a Cycloid generated by a rolling circle of diameter $50\text{ mm}$ rolling over a straight baseline without slipping for one complete revolution. Draw normal and tangent at a point $35\text{ mm}$ above the baseline.
Construct an Epicycloid generated by a rolling circle of diameter $50\text{ mm}$ rolling outside a directing circle of radius $75\text{ mm}$ for one complete revolution.
Construct an Ellipse having major axis $100\text{ mm}$ and minor axis $60\text{ mm}$ using: (a) Concentric Circles Method, (b) Oblong / Rectangle Method. Draw tangent and normal at any point.
Construct a Parabola with base $100\text{ mm}$ and axis height $70\text{ mm}$ using Tangent Method and Offset Method.

Explain Orthographic Projection: First Angle Projection vs Third Angle Projection with quadrant diagrams and standard projection symbols. Why are second and fourth quadrants not used in technical drawing?

Projection of Straight Lines: A line $AB$ of true length $80\text{ mm}$ has its end $A$ $20\text{ mm}$ above HP and $30\text{ mm}$ in front of VP. The line is inclined at $30^\circ$ to HP and $45^\circ$ to VP. Draw its front view and top view, determine apparent lengths, apparent angles $(\alpha, \beta)$, and traces (HT and VT).

The top view of a line $PQ$ measures $65\text{ mm}$ and is inclined at $45^\circ$ to reference line $XY$. End $P$ is $15\text{ mm}$ above HP and $20\text{ mm}$ in front of VP. End $Q$ is $50\text{ mm}$ above HP. Draw projections, find true length and true inclinations with HP and VP.

Projection of Planes: A regular hexagonal lamina of $30\text{ mm}$ side has one of its corners in HP. Its surface is inclined at $45^\circ$ to HP and the diagonal passing through that corner is inclined at $30^\circ$ to VP. Draw its orthographic projections.

A circular lamina of $50\text{ mm}$ diameter rests on HP on a point of its circumference with surface inclined at $45^\circ$ to HP and the diameter passing through that point inclined at $30^\circ$ to VP. Draw projections.

Projection of Solids: A pentagonal prism of base edge $30\text{ mm}$ and axis length $65\text{ mm}$ rests on one of its base edges on HP with its axis inclined at $45^\circ$ to HP and $30^\circ$ to VP. Draw its three-stage projections.

Section of Solids: A right circular cone of base diameter $50\text{ mm}$ and altitude $70\text{ mm}$ rests on its base on HP. It is cut by an auxiliary inclined plane (AIP) inclined at $45^\circ$ to HP and bisecting the cone axis. Draw sectional top view, sectional side view, and true shape of the section.

A hexagonal pyramid of base side $30\text{ mm}$ and height $70\text{ mm}$ rests with base on HP. A section plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to HP cuts the pyramid passing through a point on axis $30\text{ mm}$ from apex. Draw sectional top view and true shape of section.
Explain Sectional Views: Full Section, Half Section, Offset Section, Revolved Section, and Removed Section with schematic sketches.
Isometric Projection: Draw the Isometric Projection and Isometric View of a stepped machine block with a central cylindrical hole given its Front View and Top View orthographic projections.
Draw the Isometric view of a sphere of diameter $50\text{ mm}$ resting centrally on the top face of a square prism of base side $60\text{ mm}$ and height $30\text{ mm}$.
Explain Oblique Projection: Cavalier Projection (receding scale $1:1$, angle $30^\circ/45^\circ$) vs Cabinet Projection (receding scale $1:2$). Draw oblique view of a hollow rectangular block.

Development of Lateral Surfaces: A square pyramid of base side $40\text{ mm}$ and axis $70\text{ mm}$ rests on HP. A cutting plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to HP passes through a point on the axis $25\text{ mm}$ above the base. Draw the development of the truncated pyramid using radial line method.

Draw the development of the lateral surface of a truncated cylinder of diameter $50\text{ mm}$ and height $70\text{ mm}$ cut by a plane inclined at $45^\circ$ to base and passing through midpoint of axis using parallel line method.

Intersection of Surfaces: A vertical cylinder of diameter $50\text{ mm}$ and height $80\text{ mm}$ is penetrated completely by a horizontal cylinder of diameter $40\text{ mm}$ such that their axes intersect at right angles. Draw the orthographic views showing lines/curves of intersection.

A vertical square prism of base side $45\text{ mm}$ is intersected by a horizontal square prism of base side $35\text{ mm}$ such that their axes bisect each other at right angles and faces are equally inclined to VP. Draw the curves of intersection.
